title: 26 CFR 1.752-1, Treatment of partnership liabilities (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: Do the warranty and cost-to-complete reserves count as liabilities under section 752?
passages.excerpt: An obligation is a liability for purposes of section 752 and the regulations thereunder (§ 1.752-1 liability), only if, when, and to the extent that incurring the obligation— (A) Creates or increases the basis of any of the obligor's assets (including cash);
